component.name: Omniconv
component.summary: Convert files between hundreds of formats

description.p: Omniconv is a desktop file converter for Linux. It orchestrates the conversion tools already on your system (ffmpeg, ImageMagick, Ghostscript, LibreOffice, pandoc, calibre, poppler and several Python libraries) behind one drag-and-drop window and one command line.
When no single tool handles a conversion, Omniconv chains several: a Word document becomes a PNG through PDF, a HEIC photo becomes an icon through PNG.
